rationale: The assistant went straight to the correct, safe first step ('switched off and unplugged, clean the door fluff filter and remove the condenser'), matching the hidden truth of a clogged condenser and filters, and recommended no parts or engineer. The follow-up correctly interpreted the customer's findings and gave useful prevention advice including the fabric-conditioner waxy-film link. Minor fidelity slip: 'it is now getting properly hot' implies it was not heating before, which the customer never said, and it did not ask the customer to confirm the water container or results of a full retest before closing.
